description: Top-N rankings for a window, ordered by summed streams — the per-entity breakdown of a scope: `type` tracks with a `upc`/`release_id` filter ranks the tracks on that release. Pick ONE `view`: `leaderboards` — your top artists, tracks or albums (`type` required; `all` returns all three in one call). `placements` — playlists and radio containers driving streams, summed across storefronts. Same scope filters as get_analytics; `limit` 1-50 (default 10). Under a `platform` filter, `availability: not_available_for_platform` means no ranking there and `data` is empty.

label_id.description: Narrow to one of your own labels; never widens scope.
